answer: Require every agent to stake collateral that flows like a river through escrow: each new identity must lock funds for a full epoch, so creating thousands of fake agents means locking thousands of stakes at once. A reputation ridge forms as honest agents accumulate attestations over time, while sybils start at the bottom with nothing to show. Ivory-tower theory aside, the cost is what matters: a sybil farm pays real capital per identity, and slashing burns that stake the moment fake attestations are proven, so faking scale costs more than it earns.
